text_block_list.text:
As the scorching summer training camp came to a close
and we were preparing to return to the academy, the phone rang.

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text: "—Trainer, 'that thing' is almost finished."

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text: "I'll contact you again later, so please be sure to check it over together with Tarumae-chan then."

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text: "Well then, until next time—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Who were you talking to?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm...――

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Something's fishy.

Under Hokko Tarumae's suspicious (?) gaze,
we returned to the Academy—
—The next day.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Something you want to show me?

I nod, turn the laptop toward Hokko Tarumae,
and show her the pre-connected video call screen—

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Residents
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chaaan!!
How're you doiiing!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh— Everyone!?
Why are so many of you gathered here, what are you...?

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident A
text_block_list.text:
"All of us wanted to do something for Tarumae-chan
who's working so hard, so we made this!"

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Residents
text_block_list.text: Ready, and, TA-DAH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, she unfurled a massive cheering banner
in the center of the room, beautifully embroidered
with the words 'Star of Tomakomai, Hokko Tarumae'!

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident B
text_block_list.text:
To make this flag, not only did we folks
from Tomakomai help out, but tons of fans
from all across Hokkaido did, too!

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident A
text_block_list.text:
All of Hokkaido is cheering for you now, Tarumae-chan!
Give it your all in both the races and festivals! Hang in there!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Incredible...!
choice_data_list: Looks like they're putting this up around town.

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident B
text_block_list.text: Lately, the fans who come to see Tarumae-chan have been wanting to know about all the places and things connected to her!

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident A
text_block_list.text:
"I figured having a symbol like this
would make both us and the fans super happy!"

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident B
text_block_list.text: Whenever I talk about how Tarumae-chan used to be back in the day, everyone gets so happy~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: C-C'mon, stop bringing up embarrassing stuff...!

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident A
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, it's fine!
I'm careful about what I talk about!
...And then, everyone really starts sayin' it."

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident A
text_block_list.text: They said they were happy to hear stories about Tarumae-chan from someone from her hometown! We felt proud being able to share them too... What do you call that again?

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident B
text_block_list.text: Bow-wow, for sure!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: If anything, that's a win-win!

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident B
text_block_list.text:
Dahaha, that's right! Win-win!
Tarumae-chan, you're as smart as ever!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I can no longer—
Hehe...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer,
how involved are you in this?"
choice_data_list: I just gave them a little advice, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Then let's just go with that.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, having fans talk about me
behind my back is a little embarrassing, isn't it?"
choice_data_list: It means that much of a source of pride to the locals.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm happy to hear that.
Though if we're talking about that,
Tomakomai is also a source of pride for me—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: “I see... So that's what it was—”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...There's something I realized
I really want to do at the next festival!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Things are about to get busy...!

As summer drew to a close,
the "Big Bang Idol Fest"
was right around the corner—
